integrity: All theorem assertions supported by a symbolic argument; standalone exhaustive checks at explicitly finite lengths complement, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact generating series cover only primitive binary necklaces with at least two zeros, positive cyclic one-gaps and a unique shortest one-gap; the global coincidence fraction is upper-bounded rather than exactly enumerated. Prior broad binary border-free Galois characterization may imply the membership test but does not provide the claimed quantitative enumerations in the inspected text. No independent audit.
title: Exact enumerative coincidence of Lyndon and Galois rotations at a unique shortest gap
